raw_sections.summary:
Strategic Product & Program Management Leader 
Profile Results-driven PMP® and DASSM® certified professional with 20+ years of experience leading multi-million dollar digital transformation initiatives across BFSI domain for business and operations team. Proven track record of delivering complex product launches, managing cross-functional teams of 100+ and driving operational excellence with measurable ROI.
raw_sections.experience:
Led $8M+ portfolio implementations for Card Payment and ATM in areas of Corporate and Retail Banking primarily working with MasterCard Schemes.
Global Portfolio Strategy: Spearheaded multi-million-dollar card transformation programs launching 4 card products, ensuring compliance with PCI-DSS, ISO 20022, regulatory and MasterCard Schemes. • Delivery Management & Cost Optimization: Managed cross-functional teams of 100+ members; achieved 30% cost savings in T&M engagements and establish PMO Center of Excellence to deliver agile ways of working.
RFP & Proposal Creation: Developed comprehensive RFPs covering business cases, GTM strategy, pricing analysis, and contractual SOWs. • Card Payment and ATM Terminals: Successfully delivered multiple Card Payment Product and ATM Terminal product launches ensuring compliance and smooth integration increasing customer footfall for the banks. • Agile Transformation & Velocity: Orchestrated Agile Release Trains (ARTs) and CI/CD pipelines. Coached teams to improve delivery predictability by 25% and increased Sprint Velocity by 15%.
PMO Framework: Developed PMO governance frameworks, improving portfolio visibility and partnered with C-level stakeholders to align strategic goals with execution roadmaps.
Product Delivery: Led end-to-end rollout of 5 major products and enhancements for 40+ BFSI applications, including Card Issuance (NFC, EMV, and Tokenization), ISO 20022 and Insurance Platform Migration.
Data Migration & Infrastructure: Directed high-stakes migration of 6 million customer records with zero downtime and migrated 500+ servers to modernized cloud infrastructure for banking and insurance business. • Turnaround & Governance: Recovered distressed (RED) programs to
GREEN. Managed RFPs, identify dependencies and driving them to closure.
Change Management: Chaired Change Advisory Boards (CAB) and led training programs resulting in a 95% system adoption rate among users.
Financial Oversight: Managed Portfolio & Financial Management by defining funding strategies, optimizing revenue streams, and overseeing resource utilization and cash flow. Experienced in managing both Fixed Price and T&M engagements.
Strategic Procurement: Developed comprehensive RFPs covering business cases, roadmaps, GTM strategy, pricing, and contractual SOWs. • ERP Implementation: Led end-to-end ERP projects across Finance and HR, ensuring seamless integration with existing business ecosystems.
Architecture & Analysis: Facilitated workshops on capacity planning, technical architecture, API design, DEVOPS, CI/CD Pipeline and test strategy.
Cultural Leadership: Managed diverse, cross-functional teams across 11 nationals & time zones, fostering a culture of collaboration and performance.
Team Enablement: Upskilled teams on Product and Project processes, deliver best practices, improving maturity across tribes and functions. • Performance Management: Conducted quarterly appraisals and created team development plans, resolving conflicts and align goals against KPIs.
WORK EXPERIENCE
Oct’18 to Jul 2025
One Saving Bank – Program / Project Manager Bangalore COE.
Key Result Areas
Strategic Leadership & PMO Excellence
PMO Setup: Built PM CoE, mentored juniors, reducing delivery efforts and time by 30%. Portfolio Management: Managed Strategy & IT portfolios, drove cross-functional collaborations and dependencies. Relationship Management: Managed vendor and stakeholder relationships across internal and external partners. Resource Management: Optimized utilization via capacity planning & training. Resilience: Transformed underperforming programs into efficient programs through strategic planning and execution. Artifacts: Delivered Charters, SOWs, Capacity Plans, Dashboards, for seamless execution and operations.
Digital Transformation & Technology
Cloud Migration: Shifted legacy systems to cloud, upgraded 500+ servers, save infrastructure costs by 40%. Payments: Led ISO 20022 global payment standard implementation, mentor junior PM on stakeholder management.
Integration: Executed multi-system migrations with dependencies, gap analysis & journey mapping. ERP: Streamlined workflows, implement Scrum and Devops process, reduced manual effort by 40%. CRM: Implemented CRM analytics to optimize pipeline visibility and forecasting.
Agile Transformation & DevOps
Agile: Deployed Scrum methodology, set Agile metrics for leadership. DevOps: Built CI/CD pipelines with Azure DevOps & Jira. Velocity: Boosted sprint velocity 15%, lowered FTE costs and delivered on time. MVPs: Delivered early prototypes and established strategic architecture to reduce risks. Backlog: Defined prioritization models, managed roadmaps, led workshops & standups.
Operational Excellence & Automation
Stakeholder Management: Aligns Business, Engineering and Operations stakeholders, and deliver cohesive outcome. RPA: Automated ticket handling processes in 3 weeks, reduced support tickets by 75%. BPM: Modernized BPM applications, optimized infrastructure costs, trained 700+ users, improved performance. Testing: Directed Penetration, Performance, Load, SIT, Regression, and UAT. Efficiency: Reduced sign-off times 50% through stakeholder and tailoring method, saved 20% costs & 40% schedules. Change Management: Achieved outcomes via agile adoption training & initiatives.
Feb’15 to Jul’18
Riyad Bank – KSA as Senior Portfolio Delivery Manager
Key Result Areas
Global Portfolio & Strategic Leadership
Program Delivery: Directed $8M+ card payment portfolios, led 70+ members, delivered 2 months early. RAID: Managed RAID logs across card and ATM portfolios, proactively resolving dependencies to achieve goals. Financial Oversight: Built $5M+ worth business cases, optimized fund for operation and saved cost. Card Product: Prepaid Card Products Launched, Managed card scheme certifications, BIN Setup, oversaw transaction
processing – reconciliation, interchange fee, reports and
ATM Products: Introduced new ATM Terminal for Foreign currency dispense and revamp ATM Screens. Governance: Established agile governance & CXO dashboards for portfolio transparency. Stakeholder Management: Align Business, Engineering and Operations stakeholders, and delivers cohesive outcome. Vendor Management: Managed RFPs, solution design, pricing, ensuring vendor alignment.
Product Innovation & Digital Transformation
Payments: Built card issuance platforms, revamped digital channels CX design, integrated 100+ APIs across channels. System Integration: Drove core banking system integration work streams, aligning technology teams on system
readiness, UAT sign-offs, and cutover planning for new card products.
Roadmap / Plan: Planned and orchestrated end-to-end planning with structured milestone tracking, risk registers, and
governance cadences to ensure on-time delivery across complex, multi-team programs.
Rapid Deployment: Delivered eKYC for 6M customers in 1 month via Scrum and successful negotiation with partner on
pricing and building solid API architecture for future integrations.
UX Strategy: Produced Prototypes using Design Thinking approach to enhance customer experience for digital payments. Agile & DevOps: Designed CI/CD for ATM channels, delivered MVPs to reduce risks. Grow Market: Collaborated with Marketing for go-to-market campaign launches, aligning campaign timelines with
product readiness and ensuring consistent messaging across channels at launch.
Business Development: Led a team of product managers, designers, and engineers, partner with sales and marketing
to build new product, drive go‑to‑market strategy, and developed new business.
Data Governance & Operational Excellence
Data Migration: Migrated customer records via automated ETL with zero downtime. Process Optimization: Streamlined reconciliation, cut incident tickets 60% in 2 months. Compliance: Secured approvals from regulators & card schemes, aligned with ISO 8583/20022/SWIFT/Card Schemes. Quality Assurance: Led SIT, UAT, Pentest, and Load testing for defect-free launches.
Additional Key Achievements
Stakeholder Engagement: Secured executive/board sponsorship for multi-million initiatives.
Innovation: Drove labs & hackathons, fostering continuous improvement.
Global Expansion: Led international rollouts across multiple regions.
Customer Focus: Launched VoC programs, boosted satisfaction scores.
Vendor Contracts: Negotiated deals, saved 20% on long-term partnerships.
Training: Trained 40+ members on fundamentals of project management.
PREVIOUS EXPERIENCE
Aug 2014 to Jan 2015 May 2012 to Apr 2014 Feb 2011 to May 2012 Nov 2009 to Feb 2011 Jan 2007 to Oct 2009 Jun 2006 to Jan 2007 May 2003 to Jun 2006
Talisma – Bangalore as Project Manager Riyad Bank – KSA as Product Manager Unisys Inc. – Bangalore as Program Manager Affiliated Computer Services – Bangalore as Project Manager Mphasis an HP Company – Chennai as Project Manager Aptech Learning Services – Chennai as Associate Project Manager Hurix Systems – Chennai as Project Executive
